caption: A crash between two independent balance updates can leave a partial transfer. A local database transaction groups those updates atomically. For durable commit, required log records must reach persistent storage before acknowledgement; table pages may follow later. Recovery behavior depends on the engine. External payments need separate coordination because a database rollback cannot undo a completed external call. Test crashes before and after commit, verify balances, and audit external side effects. #systemdesign #beyondlocalhost

scenes.title: Database Crash During Update
scenes.narration: This transfer stops halfway through the update when the database suddenly crashes.

scenes.title: The Risk of Partial Writes
scenes.narration: Without a transaction, we send two separate updates. A crash after debiting account A stops execution before account B receives its hundred dollars.
scenes.note: A partial write is a data corruption risk.

scenes.title: Atomic Grouping
scenes.narration: Instead, send both updates through one local transaction. The database commits them together, or rolls back the unfinished transfer so neither change remains.
scenes.note: Simplified path: transfer through a transaction to atomic updates.

scenes.title: Durable Log Writing
scenes.narration: Before acknowledging a durable commit, the database sends the required log records to persistent storage. Modified table pages can be written later.
scenes.note: Required log records persist before durable commit acknowledgement.

scenes.title: Recovery and Rollback
scenes.narration: After restarting, recovery sends committed changes from the log back to data pages and undoes unfinished work where needed. Procedures vary by engine.
scenes.note: Recovery follows the stored log; details vary by engine.

scenes.title: The External Boundary
scenes.narration: That local transaction cannot stop or undo an external payment already sent. If it rolls back, the external side effect needs separate coordination.
scenes.note: Atomic ACID stops at the network edge.

scenes.title: Crash Resilience Checklist
scenes.narration: Test a crash during our transfer and verify both balances after recovery. Then check external side effects separately before trusting the whole workflow.

takeaway: Test crashes and verify both balances
Check external side effects after rollback
